---
title: "About"
---

**Math to Code** is an open educational project from [EulerLettersAI](https://eulerlettersai.github.io/). Its lessons alternate between mathematical explanations and executable code so readers can test each idea while it is still fresh.

## Reuse and contribute

The source is public on [GitHub](https://github.com/EulerLettersAI/math-to-code). Suggestions, corrections, and lesson proposals are welcome through repository issues.

Unless a lesson says otherwise, repository content is provided under the license in the project root.
